req.title: Redirect once when n==1
req.statement: The system shall respond with a single 302 to /get when /redirect/1 is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/1 must issue exactly one 302 redirect to /get, and the final response (after following the redirect) must be HTTP 200 with the expected JSON payload. We need: (1) a positive test confirming the 302 → /get chain works correctly with exact status codes and Location header; (2) a negative test confirming that /redirect/0 is rejected (assert=n>0 triggers 500 or 400, not a silent redirect); (3) a boundary test at n=1 (the exact threshold where the code branches to url_for('view_get') instead of _redirect), plus a contrast at n=2 to confirm the branch is not taken. Additional tests cover the redirect target URL exactly, the final 200 payload keys, and the absolute=true variant to kill boolean-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
test client does NOT follow redirects
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected Location ending in /get, got: {location}'

test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get()

def test_redirect_1_boundary_location_is_exactly_get():

tests.name: test_redirect_2_does_not_go_directly_to_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
test client does NOT follow redirects
actions: Inspect Location header — must NOT be /get
expected: Location header is NOT /get (goes to /redirect/1 instead)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: n==2 takes the _redirect branch, not the n==1 branch; boundary ±1 above threshold
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_2_does_not_go_directly_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    # n==2 must NOT jump straight to /get
    assert location != '/get', f'Expected intermediate redirect, got: {location!r}'
    assert '/redirect/1' in location or location.endswith('/redirect/1')

test_redirect_2_does_not_go_directly_to_get()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_false_gives_relative_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    # relative URL must not start with http
    assert not location.startswith('http'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location!r}'
    assert location == '/get'

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_true_gives_absolute_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.startswith('http'), f'Expected absolute URL, got: {location!r}'
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected URL ending in /get, got: {location!r}'

tests.name: test_redirect_1_response_has_no_body_only_redirect
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
test client does NOT follow redirects
actions: Check that status is 302 and not 200 or 404
expected: Status is exactly 302, not 200, not 404, not 500
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: the redirect response itself must not be a success or error; kills status-code constant mutations
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_response_has_no_body_only_redirect():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 500
